verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no feature for exporting memories in a machine-readable format. Several items are adjacent but do not earn credit. `cognee-cli push` uploads a local graph to Cognee Cloud, which is migration into the vendor's own service rather than a portable export. `cognee-cli report` produces a descriptive Graph Insight Report, not a data dump. Open-source self-hosting and RDF/OWL ontology input are related features, not export.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can export memories in a machine-readable format so the memory store is portable and not a lock-in trap
